verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for accounting software, so the axis applies. However, the evidence shows Xero only as a cloud SaaS product reached through APIs, SDKs and an MCP server bridge. Those are developer building blocks or adjacent tools, not a way to self-host the core accounting product, and nothing documents an on-premises or self-hosted deployment.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
